'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello, my friend. You've likely already heard rumors about my merchandise, yes? My guess is this Russian prick just can't stand the fact that the customers are choosing me over him. Or perhaps there's a new player trying to join the competition. In any case, this reputational damage must be dealt with immediately. Bring me some of this "poor-quality merchandise", and I'll look into it.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over the 10 western Scav weapons with very low durability

==Rewards==
* +72,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 1,500 Dollars
** 1,575 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 1,725 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Military circuit board]]
* 2× [[Military flash drive]]
{{quote|What the kurwa is this... That's not my product! Well, thank you for your work anyway. Now I have several leads, but we need to figure out where these weapons came from.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you need to hand over 10 western style Scav guns. 

Those are special weapons with very low durability (<15) that are modified and do not usually spawn on [[Scavs]] outside this event (and thus aren't listed on their [[Scavs#Equipment|equipment page]]).

The western weapon's calibers are:
* [[.300 Blackout]]
* [[.338 Lapua Magnum]]
* [[.357 Magnum]]
* [[.45 ACP]]
* [[4.6x30mm HK]]
* [[5.45x39mm]] (Only [[SAG AK]], [[SAG AK Short]])
* [[5.56x45mm NATO]] (Besides [[ADAR 2-15]], [[AK-101]], [[AK-102]])
* [[5.7x28mm FN]]
* [[6.8x51mm]]
* [[7.62x39mm]] (Only [[Mk47]], [[RD-704]])
* [[7.62x51mm NATO]] (Besides [[DVL-10]], [[T-5000M]], [[VPO-101]])
* [[9x19mm Parabellum]] (Besides [[MP-443 Grach]], [[PL-15]], [[PP-19-01]], [[Saiga-9]], [[STM-9]])
* [[12/70]] (Only [[M3 Super 90]], [[M590A1]], [[M870]])
* [[40x46mm]]
